# Publish gate report

**Going out:** landing page hero, Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK audience. No date was given.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Packed by hand in Bristol" (said twice) | On the policy list: "every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | On the policy list |
| "Free UK delivery on all orders" | **Doesn't match the policy.** The approved claim is free UK delivery on orders over £25. |

**Regulated claims (prices and offers):** The delivery line drops the £25 condition, so it is a "free" offer with the conditions hidden. That is the line most likely to cause trouble, because customers under £25 would be charged and the page would have promised otherwise.

**House style:** The hero says "packed by hand in Bristol" twice in two sentences. That is padding, so I merged them.

**Disclosure:** None needed. This is the brand's own page, with no paid partnership, affiliate link or AI-labelled content.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite):**
- Restored the £25 threshold on delivery.
- Removed the repeated "packed by hand in Bristol".

> Loose leaf tea, packed by hand in Bristol and certified organic by the Soil Association. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

**Needs a decision:**
- Confirm you want the rewrite above. It must be the exact final text, because changing it later means a new check.
- If the business really wants free delivery on all orders, the policy has to be updated by its owner first. Until then I can't clear the original line.

**Approver:** The policy doesn't name one, so I need an explicit yes from you, or the person you name, on the exact rewritten copy. No approval has been recorded, so nothing should be published yet.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "Free UK delivery on all orders.", "type": "other"}], "publish": false}
```
